content: Kooh faɗɗi cuuɓiŋ ɗe
Mi na meeksohe : Kooh faɗ faɗ cuuɓiŋ ɗe e ? Muk ! Mi ŋ haf fo ŋ ɓaah ŋ Israayel, ŋ puloh ŋ Ibrahiima, ŋ cuuɓiŋ Benyaamin.
Kooh faɗɗi cuuɓiŋ ɗe, cuuɓi a inah maañ. Ɗu inhiɗ ini Fiis ci woo ŋ ineem, ŋ saari Ilyas ñaɗtukee ŋ Israayel ci ŋ fiki Kooh.
A woosa ne : « Heɗi, ɓa apiɗ woosuuɗ ciŋ ɗa, ɓa pooksohiɗ seeƴkohaaci na seeƴkohse wuu fu ; mi, ŋ tas kiik ko kotii te ɓa ɗii waaɗ to ap. »
Waaye Kooh lof ye nga ? A woo ɗe ne : « Ŋ ɗaakɗiɗ haf fo ƴaar junni-yasna-kanak (7000), ɓi moosɗi ƴekiɗ Ba'al
Te wa mand ɗaa woti-woti, raakiɗ ɓi tas ŋ Israayel ci, ɓi kooɗu taamboh ŋ baahohiŋ Kooh.
Nik ne ɓa baahohu baahohu ɗah, in ci ɓa tum tahɗi ɓa kooɗu ; mbaa baahoh nikisɗi baahoh.
Kon ɓo' min ye woo ? Ini Israayel ci waake, ɓa raakɗaa ; e ɓi kooɗu nga ɓa raaka, ɓinooɓi, keeñ ciŋ ɓa ndengɗu ndengɗu.
Findi wa fiisohu an :

content.text: a hondohha has ciŋ ɓa hot,
a hondohha nof ciŋ ɓa kerah,

content: Te Dawuuda woyiɗ ne :
Ɓi nikɗi Yawuut gerefe'uuɗ
Kon mi na meeksohe : Andi kafnduki ɓa kafnduk, ɓa keen keen po ɓa minisɗi kuruk e ? Muk ! Waaye ɗali ɓa ɗal tahiɗ po ɓi nikɗi Yawuut eɗuuɗ muci, ne Israayel ci siis ɓa.

Nik ne a ɗali ɓa ɗal weɗ tah Adina raak ini yakki wa raak ɗah, te nik ne keeniŋ ɓa weɗ on ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ini yakki ɓa raak ɗah, kon wa wooriɗ ne Yawuut ci jen muc ɗah, ini wa onohan hey uupe yak fuuf !
Ɗu ɓi nikɗi Yawuut, mi na woye na ɗu : Ñam Apootariŋ ɗu, ŋ neɓuuɗ ŋ pangki Kooh eɗ to.
Ŋ waaɗ ne findi wa min nikoh ɗah, ɓooɓiŋ cuuɓiŋ ngo siis ɗu ŋ kosi ɗu kos, po wa muciɗ ɓi ɓo' nga ɓa.
Nik ne e ɓakɗi ɓa ɓakɗu tah Adina kerhiɗoh na Kooh ɗah, kon Kooh dokin ɓa ɗah, wa nikan ye ? Wa nikanɗi hultiŋ kaaniɗ ci e ?
Nik ne mbuuruuci koc hooliɗ wuu Kooh ɗah, ini tas ŋ muni siiɓuuɗi jen hooliɗ wuu ce ; te nik ne niiri hooliɗ wuu Kooh ɗah, naak ci na car ci namiɗ hool wuu ce.
Waaye raakiɗ car ci nihsu ŋ kidgiŋ oliiwi, te fu yi nikee car oliiw ɓaɓiɗ, fu gerefe'uusa ŋ ɗisik ci car ceem nikee, fu raakiɗ ɓak ŋ niiri, na ñif miŋ oliiwi baahiɗi.
Waaye kina yaksiɗuk ŋ car ceem. Fu tuma ɗah, kina alkoh ne a fu raan niiri haa, waaye a niiri raan ɗa.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne fu woyan ne : « Ca car ceɗ nihsu, ne ŋ gerefe'u. »
Ineem keeh, waaye e ñak kos tah ca nihsu, te fu, e kos tah ɗa tufuk. Kina yaksiɗuk ŋ ineem, waaye neƴƴoha ;
laam nik ne e car ciŋ kidgi ceɗ Kooh nihis ɗah, amba ne a faɗan ɗa haa.
Mbaa marka findi Kooh baahoh na findi a na muñɗoheeɗi in baahaaɗi. A na muñɗeeɗi ɓi keen ŋ bakaaɗ, a baahiɗ nga ɗa. Waaye fu joy gen gaƴuk ŋ baah kiŋ ɗe ; wa ɗal ineem ɗah, fu hey name nihsu.
Te ɓeɗ, ɓa risɗi ŋ kosaaɗiikiŋ ɓa ɗah, ɓa hey name gerefe'u ; laam Kooh herñiɗ ne a gerefe'is ɓa ŋ ɗiska ɓa nike.
Nik ne fu, fu yi cari nihsohu ŋ oliiwi ɓaɓ, wi fu mbaahkoh, a fu gerefe'u ŋ oliiw baahiɗ, wi nikɗi mbaahiŋ ɗa ɗah, ŋ woyisɗi ɓeɗ ɓi na hee gerefe'se ŋ oliiwi ɓa puloh.
Cuuɓ ci jen mucɗu ɗah, Israayel jen hey muce
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ waaɗɗi ne ɗu nik inhaaɗi ini ɗasɗukiɗii, po ɗu kee liiɓa ne ɗu inhiɗ, weɗ ne : Ɓak ngaŋ cuuɓiŋ Israayel risan ndeng keeñ, po cuuɓ ci cinooci jen rahas muci.
Teemb ndeem, Israayel jen hey mucɗasse, findi wa fiisohu an :

content.text: A nihis kaañ-Kooh ki nik ŋ cuuɓiŋ Yaŋhooɓa ;
mbaɗna ŋ nihsan bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa. »

content: Ini ɓa sang teyɗuk Yegɗohiŋ Muci, tahiɗ po ɓa sangiɗ ciŋ Kooh, wa nikka muuɗiŋ ɗu, waaye poyi, ɓa ris cuuɓi Kooh kooɗ, te a waaɗiɗ ɓa, sagu ambtiɗohi a ambtiɗohee na caac caŋ ɓa.
Laam Kooh baahoh ɓo' in wala a ɓeeɗuk ɓo' ɗah, inwaaso moosanɗi amb Kooh nga.
Ɗu kerhiɗeeɗi Kooh ɗeɓgaan te ɗiski wa nik ɗu yirmuuɗ taamboh ŋ ini Yawuut ci kerhiɗɗi ɗe.
Ɗiski wa nik wa mand ɗaa, kerhiɗaaɗiikiŋ ɓa ɓekiɗ yirmuukiŋ ɗu, ini Kooh waaɗ weɗ ne yirmuukiŋ ɗu ɓek yirmuukiŋ ɓa.
Kooh taƴ ɓooɓi jen ŋ kerhiɗaaɗiikiŋ ɓa, ne a yirim ɓa jen.

content.text: te waas ciŋ ɗe minɗi inhu !
po a joyya ɗe wa wirind ? »

in ci jen nikiɗ taamboh nga ɗe,
